title: Zephyrine and the Bridge
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Sebastian Kavanagh, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
